title: Wynonna Judd – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour in Springfield, MO
description: This is a live country music concert where Wynonna Judd performs songs from her project The Hard Truth, along with the voice that made her a star as one half of The Judds, who scored eight consecutive No. 1 hits before her solo career. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO. Tickets are available at HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
